question: Which of the following statements correctly defines the lyophilization process ?:

options.opa: It is a system of cold desiccation by means of a decrease of the pressure below the critical point of the water and subsequent sublimation.
options.opb: It is a system of desiccation by means of a decrease in pressure below the triple point of water and subsequent sublimation.
options.opc: It is a drying system by freezing the water contained in a sample and then raising the temperature to evaporate the ice formed.
options.opd: It is a drying system by freezing the water contained in a sample and subsequent sublimation of the ice formed.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Decrease pressure below triple point of water" -> "Sublimation of ice" -> "Desiccation" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Freeze water in sample" -> "Sublimation of ice" -> "Desiccation" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Decrease pressure below critical point of water" -> "Possible sublimation" -> "Unclear desiccation" -> 60%
CHAIN: "Freeze water in sample" -> "Raise temperature" -> "Evaporation of ice" -> "Unclear desiccation" -> 50%
analysis: Lyophilization, also known as freeze-drying, is a process that involves freezing the water in a sample and then reducing the surrounding pressure to allow the frozen water to sublimate directly from solid to gas. This process is accurately described by option opd.
